name: polaroid
title: Polaroid
description: An instant-photo frame with a handwritten caption. The photo is a built-in live placeholder (a drifting sunrise gradient); layer your own video or image over the photo window to use it.
useWhen: Media belongs in a hand-placed instant-photo frame with a handwritten caption.
A live scene should keep playing inside a stop-motion paper scene.
avoidWhen: You just need a plain rounded frame with no paper story: use backdrop with padding.
The card needs to wobble or sit at an angle: wrap it with paper-wobble and place it yourself.
author: Remocn
